_about: Methanol (1) + Methyl acetate (2): isobaric T-x-y at 100.0 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of methanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of methanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Orchilles, A. V., Miguel, P. J.[Pablo J.], Vercher, E.[Ernesto], Martinez-Andreu, A.[Antoni], Isobaric Vapor-Liquid Equilibria for Methyl Acetate + Methanol + 1-Ethyl-3-methylimidazolium Trifluoromethanesulfonate at 100 kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 52 (2007) 915-920
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 2, 3. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0025. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.10 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
